system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Hey guys! I have a query relating to a release date bug on the latest macOS client. Everything updated, fresh install. Has been persisting for about a month. Shows the correct year on artist page but then one year off on album page. See pics for details. TIA :) <URL>"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey there! What device and Spotify version is this happening on? Also, does logging out and back in help at all?"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Requesting device info is good, but should acknowledge issue and thank user first."}
